parts.text: The Haber process is used to manufacture ammonia.

parts.text: (b) The equation for the Haber process is shown. N 2 (g) + 3H 2 (g) 2NH 3 (g) ∆ H = –92 kJ / mol The reaction is reversible. The forward reaction is exothermic.
